title: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
before: Grouped-query attention was the standard way to shrink the KV cache.
problem: Even grouped keys and values dominate memory during long-context inference.
breakthrough: Multi-head latent attention: compress keys and values into a low-rank latent vector and cache that instead.
why: A far larger cache reduction than GQA, and the reason DeepSeek could serve long context so cheaply.
next: DeepSeek-V3 and R1 use it; later sparse attention built on top.
inherits: Latent KV compression as the current frontier of inference efficiency.
